verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance/GRC platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a Vanta-hosted SaaS model: tenants, regional instances, and Vanta-hosted MCP servers per region. Private integrations for on-premise systems push data into Vanta rather than letting you run Vanta yourself, and nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product.
